title: Transcervical–transparotid skull base approach for giant deep lobe pleomorphic adenoma with parapharyngeal and retropharyngeal extension: avoidance of mandibulotomy through styloidectomy
html: Deep lobe pleomorphic adenomas that extend into the parapharyngeal and retropharyngeal spaces pose substantial exposure challenges, and mandibulotomy is traditionally employed for tumors approaching the skull base. This technical note describes a giant pleomorphic adenoma (8.4 × 7.1 × 4.0 cm) involving the superficial and deep parotid lobes with significant parapharyngeal, retropharyngeal, and skull base extension in a 33-year-old man. The tumor was removed en bloc via a transcervical–transparotid skull base approach without mandibulotomy.
